summary: Heron Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose Amendment No. 1 to its Tax Benefit Preservation Plan, extending the Final Expiration Date from August 14, 2026 to August 14, 2029. The amendment, entered into with Computershare as rights agent, modifies the shareholder rights plan to preserve net operating loss carryforwards. This is a routine extension of an existing poison pill, not a special situation requiring classification under the specified categories. No transaction, board action, or strategic event is implicated beyond the timetable change.
